about: Narration for four one-off Halloween shorts (Oct. 20, 2026; Scoop: 'make a few different shorts and posts for retention rate'). Belle Gunness facts checked against Wikipedia's Belle Gunness article, Roadside America and the La Porte County Historical Society: the April 28, 1908 fire, her three children and a woman's body in the ashes, the remains of at least 11 more people on the farm, sightings for years, inconclusive DNA tests (2007-08). Trick-or-treat hours from trick-or-treat.json (checked Oct. 20). The Hesston Ghost Train's last weekend, Oct. 24-25, noon to 5, from WSBT and the 2026 tourism listings. Pushing a change here on the belle-video branch records it again (.github/workflows/belle-voice.yml).

lines.say: Men answered a La Porte widow's newspaper ads, and many were never seen again.
On April 28th, 1908, her farmhouse burned. Inside were her three children, and the body of a woman.
What they dug up next is in part two.
Was the woman in the fire really Belle Gunness?
Searchers dug up her La Porte farm, and found the remains of at least eleven more people.
For years, people said they saw Belle alive. Even DNA tests a century later couldn't settle it.
Her story is at the La Porte County Historical Society Museum.
Trick-or-treat hours for every La Porte County town. Save this.
Most towns go Saturday, October thirty-first, from five to seven in the evening.
LaCrosse goes until seven thirty. Pottawattamie Park goes early: Sunday the twenty-fifth, three to five.
Last chance: the Hesston Ghost Train.
A steam train through haunted woods, this Saturday and Sunday, noon to five. It's the last weekend this year.
